cards.name: Forerunner of the Coalition

When this creature enters, you may search your library for a Pirate card, reveal it, then shuffle and put that card on top.
Whenever another Pirate you control enters, each opponent loses 1 life.

cards.name: Dutiful Attendant
cards.oracle_text: When this creature dies, return another target creature card from your graveyard to your hand.

cards.name: Spider-Man Noir
cards.oracle_text:
Menace
Whenever a creature you control attacks alone, put a +1/+1 counter on it. Then surveil X, where X is the number of counters on it. (Look at the top X cards of your library, then put any number of them into your graveyard and the rest on top of your library in any order.)

cards.name: Demonic Lore
cards.oracle_text:
When this enchantment enters, draw three cards.
At the beginning of your end step, you lose 2 life for each card in your hand.
